title: Explain a failed release
prompt: The release you shipped yesterday broke checkout for about an hour. Your manager was not on the incident call and asks what happened. Explain it to them.

title: Explain a missed deadline
prompt: Your team delivered a feature to a client two weeks after the date it promised. The client's account manager asks why. Explain it.

title: Explain a slow page to a customer
prompt: A customer says the reports page takes ten seconds to open. You know the cause. Explain it to them, and say what happens next.

title: Say what you do at work
prompt: Someone you have just met asks what you do at work. Tell them what your job is and what a normal day looks like.

title: Justify a technology choice
prompt: You chose Postgres rather than MongoDB for a new service. A colleague who prefers MongoDB asks why. Justify the choice.

title: Say not yet to a new request
prompt: A product manager wants one more feature added to this sprint. You think it should wait. Tell them why.

title: Choose between two candidates
prompt: You interviewed two candidates for one job. Tell the hiring manager which one you would hire, and why.

title: Walk a new colleague through a release
prompt: A new colleague starts on Monday. Walk them through how a change gets from their laptop to production in your team.

title: Explain how you review code
prompt: An intern asks how you review a pull request. Walk them through what you do, step by step.

title: Walk someone through an alert at night
prompt: A new engineer joins the on-call rota. Walk them through what to do when an alert wakes them up at night.

title: Recommend a tool
prompt: Your team is choosing a tool to track its work. Recommend one you have used, and say why.

title: Recommend days in the office
prompt: Your company is deciding how many days a week people should come to the office. Give your recommendation.

title: Recommend one of two projects
prompt: Next quarter your team has time for one project: paying down technical debt, or a feature customers keep asking for. Recommend one.
